findingDetails.title: The hook kill-switch index still omits the four MK_ aliases the resolver honors and this commit added to ENV-REFERENCE
findingDetails.case: an operator exports MK_SKILL_ADVISOR_PLUGIN_DISABLED=1 and the advisor abstains, yet the table advertised as the complete inventory lists neither that name nor MK_HOOKS_DISABLED
findingDetails.recommendation: Add MK_HOOKS_DISABLED beside the master switch and the three MK_SKILL_ADVISOR_* names to the alias column, or generate both index tables from the resolver constants.

findingDetails.title: The package topology omits skill-graph/ while the directory tree and the directory itself have it
findingDetails.case: a reader who opens the package topology to find the graph code sees thirteen of fourteen folders and no purpose line for lib/skill-graph/
findingDetails.recommendation: Add skill-graph/ between shared/ and utils/ with a one-line purpose, or state that section 3 is a curated overview.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The widened fixtures or the widened doc claims leave a path that disables the advisor without being listed, or a listed path that fails to disable it.
searchLedger.rationale: DEFAULT_OFF carries only session-handover, so the ten env names are the complete switch set; the master and legacy loops cover all of them.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The launcher fixture still sets fewer names than the constant it claims to cover, or passes vacuously when the constant is empty.
searchLedger.rationale: The fixture derives from ADVISOR_DISABLED_FLAGS and asserts ten entries before the env assertion, so an empty or short constant fails loudly.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: The size assertion runs first and the child env assertion is exact.
